verdict.rationale: sevDesk's own API docs describe per-resource versioning chosen with the X-Version header (1.0–1.9). They also describe a Deprecation response header and a commitment to announce breaking changes before older versions are removed. A dated API News changelog backs this with advance breaking-change notices, such as the pagination limits announced for 30.05.2025. Missing for 10: a single formal deprecation policy page with a defined notice window or sunset timeline, URL-level major versioning beyond the fixed /api/v1 base, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We use resource versioning to handle breaking changes for our endpoints, these are rarely used and will be communicated before we remove older versions
If a resource is deprecated we return true or a timestamp since when
By 30.05.2025, we will introduce a restriction on our pagination limits for API calls that retrieve data.
